Card Q&A.q: If I don't have a level 4 or lower purple or yellow Digimon card in my trash, do both players still trash the top card of their security stack from this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
Do the [Security] effects on cards trashed by this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, just because there are no security cards to trash doesn't mean you win the game.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect when my opponent has an empty security stack, do I win the game?
If either or both players have empty security stacks, can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play a level 4 or lower purple or yellow Digimon card from my trash?

Card Q&A.a: 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card or 1 yellow level 4 or lower Digimon card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash 1 card from the top of both players' security stacks. Then, play 1 purple or yellow Digimon card with a level of 4 or less from your trash without paying its memory cost.
